subject: Re: Kickoff: mucped22 — decisions for the June close
body:
Team,

Decisions from the review:

1) We adopt the regime-scoped recommendation, exactly as Gustavo framed it: a blessed metric per bitrate regime, with mandatory human eval (through our pipeline) for cross-regime codec comparisons. The codec team pushed back on losing a single number; the 1-in-6 ordering-inversion stat ended that conversation.
2) The May extension batch is funded — same 9-rater pool, $21k, Idris signed off. Ondrej's methodology doc becomes the standard for any future rating study in the vision portfolio.
3) Emeka's annotation UI graduates from project tooling to a maintained internal tool; he'll spend 20% in June on hardening and docs.

One miss to own: we're landing three weeks later than the original April pipeline milestone. Fully worth it for rater quality, but I'll note it in the portfolio review.

Lucia
